title: poa trivialis subsp. sylvicola
intro: Poa trivialis subsp. sylvicola, commonly known as woodland bluegrass, is a subspecies of perennial grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress, improving sleep, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of woodland bluegrass are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential applications of Poa trivialis subsp. sylvicola.
